audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lucian five of seven stages including Level 6 and 2+ items, while the same page's whys say the lane is skill-matched at 3, that Poppy's trades hold at 4-5, that Keeper's Verdict turns his E into a death sentence at 6, and that her value is gold-independent late. The header also read FAV with a hard-matchup red tone, an 8.5/10 difficulty and 'Hard matchup' in the final rating — three different verdicts on one page, against a 54.43% win rate over 1229 games.
audit.why: Poppy is the favoured side here and the prose already said so; only the tokens and the difficulty number disagreed.
audit.corrected: Level 3 to Skill and Levels 4-5, 6, first item and 2+ items to Poppy, in matched full/content pairs with ratings rescaled. Levels 1 and 2 stay Lucian, matching the audited lucian__poppy mirror exactly. Difficulty set to 4.5/10 with the favoured tone and final rating.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly owned — levels 1-2 to Lucian, levels 2-3, level 6 and first item to Poppy.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never gives a number for the one cooldown it tells you to track, and never mentions that Relentless Pursuit refunds cooldown off Lightslinger attacks.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s at 445 range, but Lightslinger double-shots reduce it — so 'wait for his dash' is a moving target, and a Poppy who counts to sixteen while he farms will step up into a dash that is already back.
audit.corrected: Named the 16s base and the fact that his attacks cut it, so the advice becomes 'punish it fast', and told the player not to spend Heroic Charge into a Lucian who still holds his dash.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Lucian's Relentless Pursuit is down.
edits.after: W stops Relentless Pursuit mid-flight, but his Lightslinger shots cut its 16s short — punish the window fast.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lucian must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — but never spend E on a Lucian still holding his 445-range dash. Bait it out, then wall-stun him.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lucian's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict punts him off his kite line or back into your tower — this is the level his repositioning dash turns fatal.

notes: Deliberately not written: the _missing list claims Lucian can cancel Keeper's Verdict with Lightslinger (P). That comes from a hardCC flag misfire — Riot's passive text describes a double-shot and bonus magic damage when a nearby enemy is immobilized, with no CC of its own. I made no interrupt claim from his passive. Same for 'Lightslinger absorbs your burst' (shield flag, from 'when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally'). The full layer also still says 'your W deletes dashes' in tldr, winCon, report[0] and report[1]; that one is actually true against Lucian, so I left it and spent the length budget on the cooldown numbers instead.
